nodes.label: Task 5: removeGroupMember settle-before-remove
nodes.rationale: Replaces redistribute-on-remove with a settled-balance precondition; creator-only guard; soft-deletes membership only so history and names stay intact (no split redistribution). force option lets internal cascades bypass guards.

nodes.label: Task 5 Report: removeGroupMember
nodes.rationale: Circular import check clear: settlement.ts imports only @/db/db and @/types. deletePerson cascade updated to pass force:true. 303 tests pass.

nodes.label: Task 6: payment caps in settlement ops
nodes.rationale: Opt-in enforceCap flag so a payment can never exceed what the payer owes. Default-OFF keeps existing callers/tests unaffected. Uses owedInGroup with 0.005 epsilon.
nodes.norm_label: task 6: payment caps in settlement ops

nodes.label: Task 6 Report: payment caps
nodes.rationale: enforceCap is boolean|undefined with no default; cap guard only runs when truthy; uses resolved group-roster-canonical ids. 306 tests pass.

nodes.label: Task 7: group page pairwise + pay-a-person
nodes.rationale: Switch GroupDetailPage to pairwise engine, delete suggested-payments block, add per-member Pay action with enforceCap. Pay button shows only when you owe them (net < 0).

nodes.label: Task 7 Report: group page pairwise
nodes.rationale: Dual balance computation kept: GroupExportCard still needs old GroupBalanceSummary shape, so refreshBalances runs both computeGroupPairwiseBalances and computeGroupBalances — a double-fetch flagged for follow-up migration.

nodes.label: Task 8: PayIntoGroupDialog
nodes.rationale: New dialog distributes a lump sum across people you owe (equal/percentage/custom), capped, with remainder feedback via allocateLumpSum. Owed list built from pairwise entries with net < 0.

nodes.label: Task 8 Report: PayIntoGroupDialog
nodes.rationale: Brief assumed Radix Dialog but RecordSettlementDialog uses a custom sheet pattern (fixed inset-0 z-60 with backdrop); PayIntoGroupDialog mirrors that exact pattern instead.

nodes.label: Task 9: fix TotalSpendingDialog Unknown names
nodes.rationale: Resolve spending-chart names from the full roster including soft-deleted members, with 3-tier lookup (members prop, group_members.display_name, profiles) before falling back to Unknown.

nodes.label: Task 9 Report: TotalSpendingDialog names
nodes.rationale: Follows the same group_members.display_name fallback pattern as getBillWithDetails; query fetches all rows including soft-deleted for spending-history attribution.

nodes.label: Task A1 Report: atomic deletePerson cascade
nodes.rationale: deletePerson cascade fires exactly one sync: inner deletions suppress their syncs via suppressSync; only final deletePerson fires finalizeMutationSync. Backward compatible (existing callers sync normally).
nodes.norm_label: task a1 report: atomic deleteperson cascade

nodes.label: Task A2 Report: surface silently-dropped writes
nodes.rationale: Post-success guard: after clean sync, check hasUnsyncedLocalDataForUser; if unsynced, leave pending + increment retry_count; at STUCK_RETRY_THRESHOLD=3 surface as not_applied_change with reason_code='silently_dropped'.
nodes.norm_label: task a2 report: surface silently-dropped writes

nodes.label: Task A3 Report: wrap error-swallowing handlers with toast
nodes.rationale: 7 page handlers wrapped with try/catch + toast.error; message derives from Error object else task-specific fallback; existing finally blocks preserved for state cleanup.
nodes.norm_label: task a3 report: wrap error-swallowing handlers with toast

nodes.label: Task B1 Report: realtime recover on bundle-fetch failure
nodes.rationale: Changed 4 bundle-fetch error branches from silent return to throw; processEventSafely catch already calls pullChanges (recovery pull) and finally advances cursor, so failures route through recovery before cursor advances, preventing silent data loss.
nodes.norm_label: task b1 report: realtime recover on bundle-fetch failure

nodes.label: Task B2 Report: re-pull on tab focus/visibility
nodes.rationale: onVisibilityActive runs runSync('online') on visibilitychange/focus; the 'online' reason bypasses the backup-reason short-circuit so tab focus always triggers a real pull. Listeners removed in cleanup.
nodes.norm_label: task b2 report: re-pull on tab focus/visibility

nodes.label: Task B3 Report: data-may-be-behind stale-pull indicator
nodes.rationale: pullStale store flag set true on all sync error paths, cleared on all success paths; AppHeader shows 'Data may be behind' with amber Wifi only when online && idle && not-syncing && pullStale, prompting tap-to-refresh.
nodes.norm_label: task b3 report: data-may-be-behind stale-pull indicator

nodes.label: Task C1 Report: Migration 044 sync_conflict_integrity
nodes.rationale: Server-clock trigger stamps updated_at, replacing per-table kwenta_server_wins_<table> guards (021b); all 9 push fns rewritten RETURNS uuid[] returning applied ids; kwenta_sync merges bundle with an 'applied' key. RUNTIME-VERIFICATION PENDING (no Supabase CLI).

nodes.label: Task C2 Report: client confirm-or-fail stamping
nodes.rationale: syncRoundTrip stamps synced_at only for rows in the server's applied id map; backward-compat: if applied is undefined (pre-044 server), stamp all rows; non-applied rows untouched so they retry; canonicalization write-backs only on applied rows.
nodes.norm_label: task c2 report: client confirm-or-fail stamping

nodes.label: Task C3 Report: stop mid-round-trip overwrite
nodes.rationale: shouldApplyPulledRow skips applying a pulled row when local is unsynced and server row is older/equal, preserving in-flight edits; new-row add path unchanged; synced rows always accept pulled version.
nodes.norm_label: task c3 report: stop mid-round-trip overwrite

nodes.label: Task C4 Report: Apply again retries, Dismiss confirms
nodes.rationale: retryNotAppliedChange runs syncRoundTrip, returns true + marks reapplied only if no errors and no unsynced data; Apply again gives toast feedback and navigates on success; Dismiss requires window.confirm before permanent discard.
nodes.norm_label: task c4 report: apply again retries, dismiss confirms
